# TablesDetailPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `TablesDetailElements`, each with the method

after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.
